'''Ranks''' ---- '''Ranks''' are a cosmetic feature which would give players ranks as they progress through the game. These would appear next to players in various spots or be used to showcase level requirements. This feature was never fully implemented and now only exists in specific [[Badges]] and [[Profile Cards]], though for the latter it does not function like it should.
==Ranks== Starting from {{Level|5}} and every five [[Levels]] players would gain a new rank. These are all the possible ranks:
